section.title: Team chats
section.description: Connect the chats your team already uses. Leo turns what was said there into tasks and digests when you ask.
section.full: {count, plural, one {This workspace has # connected chat, the most it can have.} other {This workspace has # connected chats, the most it can have.}}
section.loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No chats connected yet
empty.admin: Connect a Telegram group or a Slack channel to ask Leo there.
empty.member: An admin can connect your team’s chats.

problem.botRemovedPrivate: Leo was removed from the private channel #{chat}.
problem.rightsMissing: Leo isn’t an admin of “{chat}”, so it gets only messages written to it.
problem.tokenExpired: Slack access ended. Reconnect Slack to read #{chat} again.

retention.title: Keep messages for
retention.hint: Messages of connected chats are stored {home, select, ru {in Russia} other {in the EU}}, with the rest of this workspace’s data. Older ones are erased.
retention.shorterBody: Messages older than {days} are erased from every connected chat. This can’t be undone.

fix.addAgainIntro: Add Leo to “{chat}” again: open Telegram with the link below or send the command in the group.
fix.makeAdminIntro: In Telegram, open “{chat}”, go to the administrators and add Leo. You can switch off all its admin rights: it still gets every message.
fix.inviteCopied: Invite command copied. Run it in the channel.

disconnect.title: Disconnect “{chat}”?
disconnect.body: {count, plural, one {Shosai erases the # message it kept from this chat since {since}, and Leo leaves the chat. Tasks made from it stay, with their link to the message.} other {Shosai erases the # messages it kept from this chat since {since}, and Leo leaves the chat. Tasks made from it stay, with their link to the message.}}
disconnect.bodyEmpty: Leo leaves the chat. Shosai has kept no messages from it yet.

installations.heading: Slack workspaces
installations.channels: {count, plural, =0 {No channels connected} one {# channel connected} other {# channels connected}}
installations.title: Disconnect the Slack workspace “{team}”?
installations.body: Its channels are disconnected, and Shosai erases the messages it kept from them: {channels}.
installations.bodyEmpty: Shosai forgets this Slack workspace. None of its channels are connected.
